DefiLlama's date matches the release date in UTC.

scope.note: 5,000,000,000 native SYS left the SyscoinVaultManager on Syscoin NEVM through the SPV relay, against a UTXO-chain burn that Syscoin Core recorded as a burn of the initiating party's own custom asset. The vault holds a pre-allocated native SYS supply for the UTXO-NEVM bridge (about 9.95B SYS, against about 0.92B SYS circulating per CoinGecko), so the release was unbacked issuance. Syscoin reported no compromised keys.

Not counted: about 200 later swaps and cross-chain transfers by other addresses through the imbalanced pools between 17:53 and 18:30 UTC (the arbitrage window Allbridge describes); some local swaps returned 0.2%-14% more than they paid in. The released funds were moved to Ethereum later (PeckShield, CertiK).

sources.quote: The root cause was that the swap instruction accepted the same Pool account in both the send and receive roles without enforcing that the two are different.
